summary: Flat, tree-shaded stretch beside the oval, but no cars park here and there's no clear kerbside bay.
reasons: No parked cars or parking bay anywhere on this kerb
Narrow road edge against grass verge, not open bitumen
Leads into a busy multi-lane arterial junction

best_section.where: beside the sports oval, before the kerb climbs toward the Moggill Rd junction

drivers.road: Tertiary road, lit, 60 km/h, 2 lanes; quieter here beside the park but it funnels straight into a busy multi-lane junction with turn arrows and crossing markings a short way along.
drivers.room_and_convention: No parked cars anywhere along the kerb in either image set, and no marked parking bay on this side - the road edge sits straight against a grass verge with no footpath, giving no obvious room to pull a van off the traffic lane.
drivers.houses: Screened well here: the oval and tree canopy sit between the kerb and the houses, which are set back on the far side of the road beyond the park.

flags: No parking convention observed - zero parked cars along the whole 163 m kerb
Busy multi-lane junction with turn arrows and signal markings close to the eastern end
Steep grades elsewhere on this kerb (up to 15.6%), though the best section itself is flat
sun_shade: Tree canopy from the park (south) side overhangs much of this section, giving shade for most of the day; no building shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the grass verge is firm enough to pull a van onto
